यभ् यभ्, cl. 1. P. यभति, ययाभ,
यप्स्यति, अयाप्सीत्, यब्धुम्, to know
carnally, have sexual intercourse with, lie with:
Desid. A. यियप्सते, to desire sexual intercourse.
यभन, अम्, n. copulation, sexual intercourse.
यभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be carnally known.

याभ याभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. यभ्), sexual
intercourse.
—याभ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having sexual
intercourse.

याभिस् याभिस्, ind. (inst. pl. fem. fr. the
pronom. base 3. य, see यद्), Ved. whereby, that,
in order that.
